blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Том стоял у ___ (окно) со скорбным выражением лица.
exercises.prompt: Tom stood at the window with a mournful expression on his face.
exercises.why: «у» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: У вас есть выставочный зал в городе для ___ (ваши продукты)?
exercises.prompt: Do you have a showroom for your products in the city?
exercises.why: «для» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я не могу пойти на репетицию без ___ (партитура).
exercises.prompt: I can't go to the rehearsal without my music score.
exercises.why: «без» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
